sources.title: Do you need a visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA operates this nationality-checker page on its official mfa.gov.mk consular-services domain. On 2026-08-26, normal TLS replay of both English and Albanian routes and direct-IP SNI replay timed out before any default or selected-country card/API response.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No HTTP response was returned before the normal TLS replay timeout.

sources.title: Visa requirements for entering the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: This official MFA entry-guidance URL was replayed with a normal TLS client on 2026-08-26 and timed out before retrieval. Earlier visible guidance directs nationality questions to the selector; it is not treated as an unpublished schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All information on RNM’s visa regime is available here.

sources.title: Law on Foreigners
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Gazette URL identifies the enacted Law on Foreigners. Normal TLS replay on 2026-08-26 failed certificate validation, so it is recorded only as the known legal routing provision, not as current schedule transport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Владата донесува уредба за определување на држави чии државјани мора да поседуваат виза.
